```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Load required libraries
library(tidyverse)

# Define file paths
hourly_ridership_path <- "/MTA_Subway_Hourly_Ridership__Beginning_February_2022.csv"
gas_prices_path <- "/Gasoline_Retail_Prices_Weekly_Average_by_Region__Beginning_2007.csv"

# Load the datasets
hourly_ridership_df <- read_csv(hourly_ridership_path)
gas_prices_df <- read_csv(gas_prices_path)

# Display the first few rows of each dataset
head(hourly_ridership_df)
head(gas_prices_df)
```
